issue.title: [warm-reboot] Upgrade from 201911 to 202205 is failing due to fpmsyncd crash

failure.body:
#### Description
201911->202205 warm-upgrade is failing because of fpmsyncd crash on reconciliation stage during 202205 initialization after warm-reboot.
```
Nov  7 <IPV6>.088021 sonic NOTICE bgp#fpmsyncd: :- main: Warm-Restart timer expired.
Nov  7 <IPV6>.088507 sonic NOTICE bgp#fpmsyncd: :- reconcile: Warm-Restart: Initiating reconciliation process for bgp application.
Nov  7 <IPV6>.089566 sonic INFO bgp#supervisord: fpmsyncd fpmsyncd: ../warmrestart/warmRestartHelper.cpp:295: bool swss::WarmStartHelper::compareAllFV(const std::vector<std::pair<std::__cxx11::basic_string<char>, std::__cxx
11::basic_string<char> > >&, const std::vector<std::pair<std::__cxx11::basic_string<char>, std::__cxx11::basic_string<char> > >&): Assertion `v1Iter != v1Map.end()' failed.
Nov  7 <IPV6>.545656 sonic INFO bgp#supervisord 2022-11-03 <IPV6>,544 INFO exited: fpmsyncd (terminated by SIGABRT (core dumped); not expected)
Nov  7 <IPV6>.307563 sonic INFO systemd[1]: run-docker-runtime\x2drunc-moby-216ca677eef9bbee9b1202cc3b1ddbff50a8ce9b1330da2f3fa1ea3e9afa6364-runc.F02N9R.mount: Succeeded.
Nov  7 <IPV6>.580120 sonic INFO bgp#supervisor-proc-exit-listener: Process 'fpmsyncd' exited unexpectedly. Terminating supervisor 'bgp'
Nov  7 <IPV6>.583203 sonic INFO bgp#supervisord 2022-11-07 <IPV6>,580 WARN received SIGTERM indicating exit request
Nov  7 <IPV6>.583414 sonic INFO bgp#supervisord 2022-11-07 <IPV6>,580 INFO waiting for supervisor-proc-exit-listener, rsyslogd, staticd, zebra, bgpd, bgpcfgd, bgpmon to die
Nov  7 <IPV6>.585041 sonic INFO bgp#supervisord 2022-11-07 <IPV6>,584 INFO stopped: bgpmon (terminated by SIGTERM)
Nov  7 <IPV6>.595653 sonic INFO bgp#supervisord 2022-11-07 <IPV6>,594 INFO stopped: bgpcfgd (exit status 0)
Nov  7 <IPV6>.611052 sonic INFO bgp#supervisord 2022-11-07 <IPV6>,610 INFO stopped: bgpd (terminated by SIGKILL)
```

fpmsyncd is crashing due to shown below ```assert``` during routes reconciliation.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/202205/warmrestart/warmRestartHelper.cpp#L295
```
/*
 * Compare all field-value-tuples within two vectors.
 *
 * Example: v1 {nexthop: <IP>, ifname: eth1}
 *          v2 {nexthop: <IP>, ifname: eth2}
...
bool WarmStartHelper::compareAllFV(const std::vector<FieldValueTuple> &v1,
                                   const std::vector<FieldValueTuple> &v2)
{
 ...
        assert(v1Iter != v1Map.end());
...}
```

Not 100% sure if it is root cause for fpmsyncd crash, but it looks like route entries look different in 201911 and 202205. Reconciliation logic goes through all the routes in APP_DB, compares all the attributes  and expects them to match. But there is additional "weight"" attribute in 202205, which is not present in 201911. As a result fpmsyncd is aborted.

Example of APP_DD route config in 201911:
```
<IP>:6379> HGETALL "ROUTE_TABLE:<IP>/25"
1) "nexthop"
2) "<IP>,<IP>,<IP>,<IP>"
3) "ifname"
4) "PortChannel101,PortChannel102,PortChannel103,PortChannel104"
```

Example of APP_DD route config in 202205:
```
<IP>:6379> HGETALL "ROUTE_TABLE:<IP>/25"
1) "nexthop"
2) "<IP>,<IP>,<IP>,<IP>"
3) "ifname"
4) "PortChannel101,PortChannel102,PortChannel103,PortChannel104"
5) "weight"
6) "1,1,1,1"
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Deploy 201911 image and T0 topology
3. Install 202205 image
4. Perform war-reboot
5. Check syslog already on 202205 image and observe that fpmsyncd crashed on reconciliation stage

#### Describe the results you received:
fpmsyncd crash after warm-upgrading from 201911 to 202205

#### Describe the results you expected:
No fpmsyncd crash after upgrading from 201911 to 202205

#### Output of `show version`:
* Latest 201911 image (e.g. image built on top of ```7781399bb``` hash was used)
* Latest 202205 image (e.g. image built on top of ```d2540ae31``` hash was used)
*
#### Output of `show techsupport`:
N/A

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):
N/A

resolution.title: [db_migrator] Add missing attribute 'weight' to route entries in APPL DB
resolution.description:
#### What I did
Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/12625

#### How I did it

Check for missing attribute `weight` in APPLDB route entries. If found missing this attribute is added with empty value.

#### How to verify it
Verified on physical device. 201911 to 202205 upgrade worked fine.
